name: Hotel Greif „Straudi“
beschreibung: The Hotel Greif „Straudi“ is located in a village in Tirol, surrounded by the **alpine mountain landscape**. The surroundings offer access to **hiking trails** and nearby **ski areas**. The hotel has a **restaurant with Tiroler Küche**, a **wellness area**, and a **guest garden**. The rooms are **modernly furnished** and equipped with Wi-Fi. The reception provides information about **excursion destinations** in the region. A **storage room for bicycles and ski equipment** is available. The location of the house allows direct access to **nature**.
